Name: Stardew Wiki Search
Author: thrimkom
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Stardew Wiki Search is a lightweight SMAPI mod that lets you search the official Stardew Valley Wiki without leaving the game manually. Type /wiki followed by a search term in the in-game chat box, and the mod will open the corresponding wiki search in your default web browser.
For example:
[code]/wiki Alex
/wiki Iridium Sprinkler
/wiki Skull Cavern[/code]The command is handled locally and will not appear as a multiplayer chat message.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest compatible version of SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the Stardew Wiki Search ZIP file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the extracted StardewWikiSearch folder in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Make sure the folder structure looks like this:[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── StardewWikiSearch/
        ├── manifest.json
        └── StardewWikiSearch.dll[/code]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Search the Stardew Valley Wiki directly from the in-game chat box.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports searches containing multiple words.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Opens results in your default web browser.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Prevents[/color] /wiki [color=#D4D4D8]commands from being sent as multiplayer messages.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Leaves all other Stardew Valley chat commands unchanged.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Displays usage instructions when[/color] /wiki [color=#D4D4D8]is entered without a search term.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Lists the Wiki Search command when[/color] /help [color=#D4D4D8]is entered.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Requires no configuration.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]No additional mods or content packs are required. [/color]

Manifest.Name: Stardew Wiki Search
Manifest.Description: Open a Stardew Valley Wiki search with /wiki <search term> in the in-game chat.
Manifest.Author: ctwit
